reasoning_summary: The bug is fundamentally a failure to validate property access against the expected type definition in a specific context (the @this annotation). This is a classic case of a missing or incorrect guard/validation logic in the type-checking algorithm, which is the definition of the Checking ODC type.

The issue is a failure to perform a type-check validation that is expected to occur.
